records.issue_text: app/assets/javascripts/admin/components/embeddable-host.js.es6:47 — Delete does not attach `popupAjaxError` (unlike save). A failed DELETE leaves the row in place with an unhandled rejected promise and no feedback explaining why the host was not removed.
records.rationale: The diff shows the delete action calls `this.get('host').destroyRecord().then(...)` with no `.catch`, while the save action in the same file uses `.catch(popupAjaxError)`. A failed DELETE would produce an unhandled rejected promise with no user feedback, which is a real error-handling gap introduced by this new code.
